thread:
alex: heads up — onboarding sampleapp failed for a customer after key rotation. they had REDWOOD_API_KEY mounted as a docker secret but our container image expects REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY so runtime fell back to org key and auth flipped to 401s. :facepalm:

maya: ouch. can you paste the exact env that was set?

alex: yup — docker-compose snippet:

alex: ```
services:
  app:
    image: redwood/sample-onboard:latest
    secrets:
      - source: REDWOOD_API_KEY
        target: /run/secrets/redwood.key
```

samir: that explains it. our Node SDK prioritizes REDWOOD_API_KEY, but the Python SDK checks REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY first. different fallback rules + rotation meant the running process never reloaded the new project-scoped key.

lin: so two bugs: env var naming mismatch across SDKs, and no dynamic reload on secret rotation inside container.

maya: also the SDK retry logic masks the 401s — it keeps retrying same cached token for 2s and then gives up, which made the sampleapp look like a network flake. we should surface a clearer error when token invalid.

samir: agree. proposed small fixes: 1) standardize on REDWOOD_API_KEY in docs and all SDKs (backcompat alias REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY), 2) add a env-var precedence doc block, 3) add an env-watch hook for file-backed secrets (watch + reload token), 4) improve 401 handling so app logs `auth: invalid/rotated key` once, not generic retries.

alex: +1. also add a short troubleshooting snippet in sampleapp README about docker secret vs env var and how to test rotation locally (e.g., `docker secret update` or swap file).

lin: i can draft the SDK PRs. which repo should own the alias shim? runtime-commons or each SDK?

maya: put canonical shim in runtime-commons so all SDKs import behavior. then each SDK can optionally add file-watch helpers.

samir: opened DEVEX-487 to track this. I'll add acceptance criteria: parity tests for env var names across JS/Python/Go and an e2e where we rotate a mounted file and assert the process picks up new token within 5s.

alex: perfect. low-risk patch: runtime-commons alias + improved log message. bigger followup: file-watch util and sampleapp README updates.

deploy-bot: deployed patch runtime-commons@v1.12.5 to staging (change: env alias + clearer 401 logs) — CI green.

maya: can we backport to last stable? customers on 1.x will hit this during rotation.

samir: scheduling backport to 1.11.x, will PR today.

lin: i'll start the parity test matrix (JS/PY/Go) and ping when ready for review.

alex: thanks team — feel better having a concrete rollout plan. I'll update the onboarding checklist to call this out.
